question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (5)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**groups**" refers to** a number of people or things that are located, gathered, or classed together. **(समूह)
 
• In the context of the passage,** "from all major animal groups"** means the data was collected from different categories or classifications of animals.
 
• The other options: "**bands**," "**flock**," and "**troupes**" do not fit the context of categorizing all major animal species as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *To better understand how native and non-native species respond to extreme weather events, the scientists behind the new study reanalysed information from 443 peer-reviewed studies on how species responded to wildfires, droughts and storms. In all, they gathered data on 187 non-native species and 1,852 native species from all major animal groups__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bands (पट्टियाँ)**: refers to a flat, thin strip or loop of material.
 
• **Flock (झुंड)**: refers to a number of birds of one kind feeding, resting, or traveling together.
 
• **Troupes (दल)**: refers to a group of dancers, actors, or other entertainers who tour to different venues.
